title: Causal Syntax Circuits in CodeLMs: Budget and Probe Decide What Looks Localised
abstract: arXiv:2610.20683v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code models write Python when the prompt does not say which language to use. We ask a mechanistic question about that habit: is it produced by a small, findable group of components inside the model? We run one pipeline---mean ablation, activation patching, greedy circuit extraction, a random-control significance test, and activation steering---over 55 model-language settings spanning ten open code models (five base and five instruction-tuned), three target languages (Rust, C#, PHP), two prompt suites, and two component budgets. We report five findings. First, the preference is large, grows with model size, and survives instruction tuning: it is larger on every instruction-tuned checkpoint than on its base version, by 12% on average. translated_title: 代码语言模型中的因果语法电路：预算与探针决定了什么看起来是局域化的
translated_abstract: 当提示中没有说明使用哪种语言时，代码模型会默认编写Python。我们针对这一习惯提出了一个机制性问题：它是否由模型内部一小群可找到的组件所产生？我们在55个模型-语言设置上运行了一条统一的实验流程——均值消融、激活修补、贪心电路提取、随机对照显著性检验以及激活引导——涵盖十个开源代码模型（五个基础版和五个指令微调版）、三种目标语言（Rust、C#、PHP）、两套提示集和两种组件预算。我们报告了五项发现。第一，这种偏好很大，随模型规模增长，并且在指令微调后依然存在：每个指令微调版本上的偏好都大于其对应的基础版本，平均高出12%。第二，其测量大小主要取决于探针的属性；用XLCoST平行函数替换我们对齐的提示后，在相同模型上的同一测量值从约1.6降至约0.01。第三，当……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过均值消融、激活修补、贪心电路提取与激活引导的统一流程，系统研究了代码语言模型默认偏好Python的内部机制，发现该偏好随模型规模增长并在指令微调后仍存在，但其局域化表现高度依赖于组件预算与探针的选择。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically investigates the mechanistic basis of code language models' Python preference via a unified pipeline of mean ablation, activation patching, greedy circuit extraction, and activation steering, finding that the preference grows with model size and survives instruction tuning, while its apparent localisation is largely determined by the component budget and probe choice.
